$note: Procurement concept of the Ludwigsburg school as data. Applied on top of the module seeder defaults, key by key; a missing key keeps the default. Values are in the project currency (EUR). All names are invented trade descriptions, no real firms.

advance_reason.en: Prefabricated timber facade elements: the production slot must be reserved before the shell tender closes, so the facade can follow the concrete frame without a gap.
advance_reason.de: Vorgefertigte Holzfassadenelemente: Der Produktionsplatz muss vor Ende der Rohbauausschreibung gesichert werden, damit die Fassade ohne Pause dem Betonskelett folgen kann.

notes.en: Design services under VgV, open procedure with EU-wide notice. HOAI fees for building, technical equipment, structural design and outdoor facilities; evaluation on price and quality. Awarded after the Gemeinderat decision on the competition result.
notes.de: Planungsleistungen nach VgV im offenen Verfahren mit EU-weiter Bekanntmachung. HOAI-Honorare fuer Gebaeude, Technische Ausruestung, Tragwerksplanung und Freianlagen; Wertung nach Preis und Qualitaet.

notes.en: VOB/A trade lots in the order of the build: 1 shell (excavation, concrete frame), 2 timber frame facade, 3 roofing and photovoltaic, 4 heating and ventilation, 5 sanitary, 6 electrical and building automation, 7 interior fit-out, 8 external works. GAEB x83 tender documents per lot; award after the Technischer Ausschuss and the Gemeinderat, then the standstill period. Works beside the running school: noise and delivery windows are part of every lot.
notes.de: VOB/A-Fachlose in der Reihenfolge des Baus: 1 Rohbau (Aushub, Betonskelett), 2 Holzrahmenfassade, 3 Dach und Photovoltaik, 4 Heizung und Lueftung, 5 Sanitaer, 6 Elektro und Gebaeudeautomation, 7 Ausbau, 8 Aussenanlagen. Leistungsverzeichnisse als GAEB x83 je Los; Vergabe nach Technischem Ausschuss und Gemeinderat, danach Wartefrist.

notes.en: Specialist lots with a supply part: timber facade elements (prefabricated), Mensa production kitchen, sports hall floor to DIN 18032. Restricted procedure after a public participation round; the sports hall floor and the kitchen are scheduled for the summer-holiday window.
notes.de: Fachlose mit Lieferanteil: Holzfassadenelemente (vorgefertigt), Mensa-Produktionskueche, Sporthallenboden nach DIN 18032. Nichtoffenes Verfahren nach oeffentlichem Teilnahmewettbewerb.

notes.en: Classroom furniture, teaching equipment and IT, called off from the municipal framework agreement for schools.
notes.de: Klassenzimmermoebel, Lehrmittel und IT, abgerufen aus der Rahmenvereinbarung der Stadt fuer Schulen.

notes.en: Construction management and project control services for the school building office, with safety coordination for works beside the running school.
notes.de: Baumanagement und Projektsteuerung fuer das Hochbauamt, einschliesslich SiGeKo fuer Arbeiten neben dem laufenden Schulbetrieb.

notes.en: Facility services for the first two years after handover: building automation support and kitchen maintenance.
notes.de: Betriebsleistungen fuer die ersten zwei Jahre nach Uebergabe: Gebaeudeautomation und Kuechenwartung.

free_names: Building services installer for heating, ventilation and sanitary

name.en: Prequalification for works beside a running school
name.de: Eignungspruefung fuer Arbeiten neben dem laufenden Schulbetrieb

reference.project_name: All-day primary school with sports hall
reference.excluded_rationale: Below the pass mark on school references; no proof of works beside a running school

framework.title: Classroom furniture and IT equipment framework
framework.scope: Classroom and Mensa furniture, teaching equipment and IT devices for municipal schools, called off per school project
framework.source_procedure_ref: Open procedure under VgV, framework award by the city

soundings.findings: Five regional contractors interested; two prefer to bid the shell together with the external works. The school holiday window for noisy works was welcomed.
Only a few producers can deliver prefabricated facade elements in this size; production slots are booked for nine months ahead.
soundings.mitigation: Advance package to reserve the production slot; the facade lot is tendered before the interior lots.

soundings.findings: Seven installers answered, four with capacity from next spring. The heat pump and ventilation controls are the open points.
Kitchen equipment suppliers need the approved hygiene concept before they price the production line.
